name: TF-IDF (Term Frequency - Inverse Document Frequency)
when_to_use: Identify the most important/distinctive words per document within a corpus (comparing two or more documents); the variable is term frequency per document.
notes: Depends on internet access for gutenberg_download().

expected_input.question: Which words most distinguish documents in a corpus?

plain_explanation.purpose: Gives each word an importance score: high if frequent in one text and rare in the others.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When you want to find the words that truly characterize each document.
plain_explanation.data_needed: A text column, one document per row.
plain_explanation.example: Find the terms that distinguish each group of complaints.
plain_explanation.diagram: word common to all -> low score | word only in this text -> high score
